Our strategy is centered on three priorities: (i) strengthening our e-commerce business to build the Evolve brand, educate the market, and establish credibility for a new category of pest management products; (ii) expanding our direct business-to-business (“B2B”) operations through a professional sales organization focused on targeted vertical markets for both Evolve and ContraPest; and (iii) increasing our…

As consumer awareness and adoption continue to grow, we believe our expanding base of customer reviews, subscriptions, and brand recognition will also support broader commercial adoption of our products.

Building on this foundation, we are expanding our B2B business with a disciplined, vertical-market sales strategy that targets opportunities across commercial, government, pest management, agribusiness, retail, zoo and sanctuary, and international markets.

These include growth in Evolve revenue, the mix of revenue generated through our direct-to-consumer channel, gross margin performance, repeat purchases and subscription activity, expansion of customer relationships across targeted commercial and government verticals, and adoption of our products and services by new customers.

The increases in marketing and advertising and professional fees reflect the increased investment in brand and product awareness, and are expected to moderate as the Company reduces its reliance on consultants who supported personnel transitions within the sales and marketing organizations and completes its strategic initiatives.
As the personnel transitions within the sales and marketing organizations and these strategic initiatives have largely been completed, we expect consulting costs to moderate in the coming quarters.
With the sales and marketing organizations now established and continuing to evolve, we expect B2B sales to increase.

Since our inception, we have incurred operating losses related to our research and development activities and commercialization efforts, with a net loss of $5.9 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, and we expect these losses to continue for the near future.
Our projected cash runway does not assume the receipt of additional capital from equity issuances, debt financings, strategic partnerships, or other external sources.

While we have evaluated and continue to evaluate our operating expenses and have focused our resources on the successful commercialization of fertility control products in the United States, additional financing will be needed in order to fund our operating losses before achieving our revenue and margin targets and becoming profitable and generating positive cash flows.
We may never achieve profitability or generate positive cash flows, and unless and until we do, we will continue to need to raise capital through equity or debt financing.
If revenue growth does not occur at anticipated levels, or if expenses exceed current expectations, we may be required to seek additional financing sooner than currently anticipated.
In addition, we will continue to incur costs associated with operating as a public company.
In particular, we expect to incur increased expenses as we:
• explore strategic partnerships to enable us to penetrate additional target markets and geographical locations;
We will need additional financing to fund these continuing and additional expenses.

dropped.t: The Company plans to release its definitive third quarter financial results the week of November 9, 2026.

The Company expects its definitive third quarter financial results to reflect continued momentum in e-commerce, including higher subscription revenue, which is expanding the recurring component of SenesTech’s revenue base, as well as increasing traction in B2B.

“This is another quarter demonstrating progress on the plans and strategies we have previously announced, and our full third quarter financial results are expected to reflect that progress across the commercial model we have been building.

With many of the investments and transition costs incurred earlier in the year increasingly behind us, coupled with strong revenue growth and improved unit economics, we expect continued, improved metrics going forward,” Edell concluded.

These include statements regarding the Company’s expected third quarter 2026 revenue, anticipated momentum in e-commerce and increasing traction in B2B, expected progress across the Company’s commercial model, and anticipated continued, improved metrics going forward.
